title: Open Values Node Index v0.1
description: A list of the things a reader can look up on the site besides single entries: brands, the companies that own them, labels such as "organic", and errands. The data build writes one file per kind (brands.json, companies.json, tags.json, errands.json), and the site's search and node pages read them.

format.description: Names this file's format. Always "ovs-node-index"; brands.json, companies.json, tags.json and errands.json all use it.

type.description: Which kind of node this file holds: "brand", "company", "tag" or "errand". Missing in the hand-written sample.json.

version.description: The version of the format this file follows, such as "0.1".

built.description: The date of the source data this file was built from, as YYYY-MM-DD.

minItems.description: The fewest entries a node needs to be listed. Brands need 2; tags take the number from content/tags.json.

source.description: The file or files this index was built from, as paths in the repository.

longTail.description: Brands only: how many brand names were left out because they appear on fewer than 2 entries.

longTailItems.description: Brands only: how many entries carry one of those left-out brand names.

descriptorItems.description: Brands only: how many entries have a brand field that is not a usable brand name, such as "n/a" or a value listed in content/non-brand-values.json. These entries are not grouped under any brand.

id.description: The node's id, in the form ovs:<type>/<slug>, such as "ovs:brand/nescafe".

type.description: Which kind of node this is: "brand", "company", "tag" or "errand".

label.description: The name shown to readers, such as "Ben & Jerry's".

aliases.description: Other spellings or names for this node. Ask search matches them.

items.description: How many entries in the commons carry this brand or tag.

categories.description: The ids of the categories this node appears in, such as "coffee". For a company, the categories its listed brands appear in; for an errand, the categories its steps use.

ownedBy.description: Brands only: the id of the company node that owns this brand, from the ownership map in app/edges.json. Null when no owner is recorded.

top.description: Brands only: up to three of this brand's highest-scoring entries.

reads.description: One or two plain sentences shown on the node's page, saying what it is. For a company, the build writes how many brands the ownership map links to it.

brands.description: Companies only: the ids of brand nodes this company owns that appear in the commons.

brandNames.description: Companies only: the names of every brand the ownership map links to this company, whether or not the brand appears in the commons.

ownershipSources.description: Companies only: one record per ownership link, with the source that backs it.

kind.description: Tags only: "certification" (a third party checks the claim), "property" (a feature of the product) or "topic".

receipt.description: Tags only: a link to the page that backs the tag, such as the certifier's site. Null when there is none. Certification tags must have one.

output.description: Errands only: what running the errand produces. The build always writes "list".

steps.description: Errands only: the steps in order. Each names a category id, a label, whether to pick "one" or "several", and a short note.

cat.description: The id of the category the entry is in.

code.description: The entry's code within that category, usually its barcode.

score.description: The entry's score from 0 to 100, using that category's default weights.

from.description: The id of the brand as written in the ownership map, app/edges.json.

brand.description: The id of the matching brand node in brands.json, or null when that brand has no node there.

brandName.description: The brand's name as shown to readers.

source.description: A link to the source that records this ownership.

asof.description: The date the ownership map gives for this link, usually as YYYY-MM-DD.
